definitions.explanation: The rails and supporting structures on which trains run. The physical infrastructure of a railway.

examples.japanese: {線路|せんろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らないでください→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Please do not enter the railway track.

examples.japanese: {線路|せんろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The train is delayed due to track construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{線路|せんろ}⟦{沿|ぞ}い→沿い：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I often walked along the road by the railway tracks.
examples.notes: 線路沿い = along the railway tracks

notes:

- {線路|せんろ}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (track construction/maintenance)
- {線路|せんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross the tracks)
